relation.rationale: Difference between long s (ſ) and short s (s) in the same word form.
Chriſti is the genitive singular form, while Chriſtus is the nominative singular form of the same word.
The readings differ between the possessive pronoun 'ſeiner' (his) and the adjective 'eigner' (own), which are distinct words with different meanings.
